# Tracing the Steps

Let me track position carefully, assuming I start at position (0, 0) and always face forward (north).

| Step | Action | Position |
|------|--------|----------|
| Start | Facing forward (north) | (0, 0) |
| 1 | 3 steps forward | (0, 3) |
| 2 | 3 steps backward | (0, 0) |
| 3 | 3 steps backward | (0, -3) |
| 4 | 7 steps left (west) | (-7, -3) |
| 5 | 7 steps right (east) | (0, -3) |
| 6 | 8 steps backward | (0, -11) |
| 7 | 4 steps backward | (0, -15) |

**Final Position:** (0, -15)  
**Starting Position:** (0, 0)

I end at position (0, -15), which is 15 steps south of the starting point. I do not return to the starting point.

ANSWER: No
